title: Verlet Rig — Soft-Body Sandbox
description: Build, drag, and drape springy soft-body rigs with real Verlet physics, then save, export, or share them.
concept: A physics sandbox built on Verlet integration and iterative constraint relaxation. Sculpt cloth, rope, blobs, and pendulum chains with dedicated node/spring/pin/cut tools, tune gravity, wind, stiffness, and damping live, then persist your creation to the browser, download it as JSON, snapshot it as a PNG, or hand a friend a shareable link that rebuilds the exact rig.
features: 5 hand tools: drag, add-node, add-spring, pin/unpin, cut (delete node or spring)
4 generated presets (cloth swatch, hanging rope, soft blob, pendulum chain) plus a blank canvas
Live physics sliders — gravity, wind, stiffness iterations, damping — with optional floor collision
Save named rigs to localStorage, reload or delete them from a running list
Export/import full rig as downloadable JSON, one-click PNG snapshot export, and copy-a-share-link that encodes the whole rig in the URL hash

interaction.mouse: Pick a tool, then click/drag nodes on the canvas to build and manipulate the rig
interaction.click: Add nodes, connect springs, toggle pins, or cut connections depending on the active tool
interaction.touch: Full touch support via Pointer Events — drag, tap-to-add, tap-to-pin/cut all work on phones
